card.name: Online and digital before web content
card.fires_on: Words like online, digital, electronic and on-line placed before nouns such as library, database, article or identity. Also fires on a few words that open a list of content actions, such as 'to' or a comma before add, exchanged.

modes.label: Online/digital modifiers
modes.description: The adjective online, digital or electronic comes right before a noun about web resources.

modes.label: Content-action lists
modes.description: A small word or comma just before verbs like add, edit, exchange in descriptions of web content.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted words are a mixed set with no common theme.
card.plain: It spots words like online or digital that introduce internet-based resources or content.
